data.body: Generated shibuya/index.html + style.css + script.js; checks passed: no :is()/position:fixed, all @keyframes shibuya-prefixed, zero ids, no @import, no window/document listeners, CSS verified through build.js transformCss (all selectors prefixed), standalone boot per contract; left uncommitted per brand-page skill

REVIEW (cold, agent:fable-5-reviewer): PASS — no rework needed, nothing fixed inline. Verified §10 structure element-by-element (night ground, aria-hidden canyon w/ 2 rotateY walls under one shared perspective + mid/far depth bands + .canyon-end haze, street-glow layer, scroll-owning .street, hero stack w/ vertical neon-karaoke name + upright konbini 渋谷 + 営業中 lantern, off-centre marquee w/ visually-hidden real text, Beer Yellow board-panel letter, 3 link signs of 3 species/hues/offsets (board-tube kusuri GitHub, backlit konbini panel Twitter, tube-box izakaya Email), exactly one .sign-dying (decorative), paper-lantern footer). §10 'The test': all items pass — 7 neons present, 4+ species, 3+ vertical runs, flicker floor 0.55 w/ 4 dips/7.3s, no colour-on-colour, all readable pairings recomputed glow-off (12.8–18.9, worst letter 12.8), one central vanishing point, all wall/depth content aria-hidden, readable content flat+unfiltered+near, static scene, reduced-motion leaves signs steady-lit (CSS overrides + JS early-return), no horizontal scroll at 320px (measured streetSW=320, maxRight=300 via instrumented headless-Chrome harness; note: headless clamps window to 500px min, so raw 320 screenshots are crops — forced body width instead). Contract: ran build.js transformCss in isolation (extracted, no side-effect rebuild) — transforms clean, all selectors scoped, :root/html/body dedupe correct; no :is()/:where(), no position:fixed, no ids, all 5 @keyframes shibuya-prefixed, no @import/@font-face, no literal </style> or </script>, no window/document listeners (matchMedia read only), no styles on root, registry+boot lines correct, html/body property overlap consistent. HTML tag-balance clean (Python parser), JS passes node --check, folder serves 200. Headless renders at 1440/320 look genuinely Shibuya. Minor non-blocking notes: street-glow adds a 4th linear --wet streak beyond the 3 radials (within palette vocabulary); focus-visible uses outline:none relying on halo brightening as the indicator.
